4923-king-midas-a-romance.title: King Midas A Romance
4923-king-midas-a-romance.creator: Upton Sinclair
4923-king-midas-a-romance.description: A book by Upton Sinclair. e two weeks, the ones that usher in the May, that bear the prize of all the year for glory; the commonest trees wear green and silver then that would outshine a coronation robe, and if a man has any of that prodigality of spirit which makes imagination, he may hear the song of all the world.

63989-halftripper.title: Halftripper
63989-halftripper.creator: Unknown
63989-halftripper.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Of course, space cafard goes tragically further. A new man usually succumbs his first few hours in space, if he is going to get it at all. He probably makes it to the next planet, sometimes not; sometimes he goes incurably mad, right off the bat. But even if he does make it, wild horses could never get him on another rocketship. He becomes a halftripper, marooned on an alien world.

arxiv-2006-06843.title: Robust optimization and inference on manifolds
arxiv-2006-06843.creator: Lizhen Lin, Drew Lazar, Bayan Sarpabayeva, and David B. Dunson
arxiv-2006-06843.description: Abstract . We propose a robust and scalable procedure for general optimization and inference problems on manifolds leveraging the classical idea of ‘median-of-means’ estimation. This is motivated by ubiquitous examples and applications in modern data science in which a statistical learning problem can be cast as an optimization problem over manifolds.

arxiv-2111-04318.title: Auto-Encoding Knowledge Graph for Unsupervised Medical Report Generation
arxiv-2111-04318.creator: Fenglin Liu, Chenyu You, Xian Wu, Shen Ge, Sheng Wang, Xu Sun
arxiv-2111-04318.description: Abstract Medical report generation, which aims to automatically generate a long and coherent report of a given medical image, has been receiving growing research interests. Existing approaches mainly adopt a supervised manner and heavily rely on coupled image-report pairs. However, in the medical domain, building a large-scale image-report paired dataset is both time-consuming and expensive.

arxiv-2303-06500.title: Diffusion-Based Hierarchical Multi-Label Object Detection to Analyze Panoramic Dental X-rays
arxiv-2303-06500.creator: Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci, Sezgin Er, Enis Simsar, Anjany Sekuboyina, Mustafa Gundogar, Bernd Stadlinger, Albert Mehl, Bjoern Menze
arxiv-2303-06500.description: Abstract Due to the necessity for precise treatment planning, the use of panoramic X-rays to identify different dental diseases has tremendously increased. Although numerous ML models have been developed for the interpretation of panoramic X-rays, there has not been an end-to-end model developed that can identify problematic teeth with dental enumeration and associated diagnoses at the same time.

arxiv-2406-01529.title: How to Count Coughs: An Event-Based Framework for Evaluating Automatic Cough Detection Algorithm Performance
arxiv-2406-01529.creator: Lara Orlandic, Jonathan Dan, Jérôme Thevenot, Tomas Teijeiro, Alain Sauty, David Atienza
arxiv-2406-01529.description: Abstract Chronic cough disorders are widespread and challenging to assess because they rely on subjective patient questionnaires about cough frequency. Wearable devices running Machine Learning (ML) algorithms are promising for quantifying daily coughs, providing clinicians with objective metrics to track symptoms and evaluate treatments.

arxiv-2409-04248.title: The Second-Level Preheating
arxiv-2409-04248.creator: Norma Sidik Risdianto, Apriadi Salim Adam, Lalu Zamakhsyari
arxiv-2409-04248.description: Abstract This paper proposes two levels of preheating for the inflaton that is non-minimally coupled with gravity. The first level, later named by the quadratic regime, corresponds to the matter-dominated era and is responsible for draining the inflaton’s energy density.

arxiv-2508-02633.title: Neural subspaces, minimax entropy, and mean–field theory for networks of neurons
arxiv-2508-02633.creator: Luca Di Carlo, a Francesca Mignacco, a,b Christopher W. Lynn, c and William Bialek a,b
arxiv-2508-02633.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Luca Di Carlo, a Francesca Mignacco, a,b Christopher W. Lynn, c and William Bialek a,b. Recent advances in experimental techniques enable the simultaneous recording of activity from thousands of neurons in the brain, presenting both an opportunity and a challenge: to build meaningful, scalable models of large neural populations. Correlations in the brain are typically weak but widespread, suggesting that a mean-field approach might be effective in describing real neural populations, and we explore a hierarchy of maximum entropy models guided by this idea.

britannica-1911-tichborne-claimant-the.title: Tichborne Claimant, The (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tichborne-claimant-the.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tichborne-claimant-the.description: Article 'Tichborne Claimant, The' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. identical with Arthur Orton (1834–1898), the son of a Wapping butcher, who had deserted a sailing vessel at Valparaiso in 1850, and had received much kindness at Melipilla in Chile from a family named Castro, whose name he had subsequently elected to bear during his sojourn in Australia.

pmc-10596119.title: Impact of air pollution on mortality: geo-epidemiological study in French-speaking Africa
pmc-10596119.creator: L Capitanio, L Josseran, S Ratte, S Gautier
pmc-10596119.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). According to the WHO, air pollution is responsible for 90% of deaths in Africa. However, few data on exposure to air pollution is available, and studies are rare, particularly in French-speaking Africa. This study aims to investigate the impact of air pollution on mortality in 13 French-speaking African countries (Algeria, Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Guinea, Madagascar, Mali, Morocco, Democratic Republic of Congo, Senegal, Tunisia).

pmc-10605266.title: Alveolar Ridge Preservation with Autologous Platelet-Rich Fibrin (PRF): Case Reports and the Rationale
pmc-10605266.creator: Cemal Ucer, Rabia S. Khan
pmc-10605266.description: In dental implantology, alveolar ridge preservation (ARP) has emerged as a standard technique to address dimensional changes that affect alveolar ridge morphology following tooth loss. Various alternative graft materials, including xenografts, alloplasts, and allografts, have been effectively employed in fresh extraction sites for ARP.

pmc-10632149.title: Vagal sensory neurons mediate the Bezold–Jarisch reflex and induce syncope
pmc-10632149.creator: Jonathan W. Lovelace, Jingrui Ma, Saurabh Yadav, Karishma Chhabria, Hanbing Shen, Zhengyuan Pang, Tianbo Qi, Ruchi Sehgal, Yunxiao Zhang, Tushar Bali, Thomas Vaissiere, Shawn Tan, Yuejia Liu, Gavin Rumbaugh, Li Ye, David Kleinfeld, Carsen Stringer, Vineet Augustine
pmc-10632149.description: Visceral sensory pathways mediate homeostatic reflexes, the dysfunction of which leads to many neurological disorders1. The Bezold–Jarisch reflex (BJR), first described2,3 in 1867, is a cardioinhibitory reflex that is speculated to be mediated by vagal sensory neurons (VSNs) that also triggers syncope. However, the molecular identity, anatomical organization, physiological characteristics and behavioural influence of cardiac VSNs remain mostly unknown.

pmc-11286752.title: Fe3O4@SiO2@NTMPThio-Cu: a sustainable and eco-friendly approach for the synthesis of heterocycle derivatives using a novel dendrimer template nanocatalyst
pmc-11286752.creator: Sahar Peiman, Behrooz Maleki
pmc-11286752.description: In this research, Fe3O4@SiO2@NTMPThio-Cu was introduced as a novel and green heterogeneous nanocatalyst with a dendrimer template that is environmentally friendly and reusable based on Fe3O4@SiO2. In this way, magnetic silica nanoparticles were first modified with cyanuric chloride, followed by melamine and thiosemicarbazide, and ultimately, it’s decorated with the cost-effective metal copper.

pmc-11399005.title: Improving quality of breast conservative surgery for lower quadrants cancer in small and medium sized breasts: Crescent technique versus J mammoplasty
pmc-11399005.creator: Giuseppe Falco, Ljuba Morando, Giulia Borgonovo, Evelina Begnini, Saverio Coiro, Monica Foroni, Eugenio Cenini, Fabio Castagnetti, Simone Mele, Guglielmo Ferrari
pmc-11399005.description: BackgroundFor medium/small size breast, breast conserving surgery (BCS) is usually associated to poor cosmetic results. The objective of the study is to evaluate oncological safety and cosmetic results comparing the “Crescent” and the “J” mammoplasty technique and to develop an algorithm for the treatment of breast cancer located in lower quadrants in medium/small breast.

pmc-11517108.title: Adolescent mental health literacy and help-seeking behaviours. Cross-Sectional survey in Barcelona
pmc-11517108.creator: M Boixadós Anglès, E Hernández Encuentra, R Casañas Sánchez, J Martín Fernández, F Lalueza Bosch, L Merino Rubio
pmc-11517108.description: BackgroundAdolescents’ mental health information and help-seeking is critical for preventing the development of mental disorders. This study aims to examine the relationship between mental health literacy and information and help-seeking behaviours, as well as the effects of age and gender.MethodsA cross-sectional online survey on a representative sample of 2,240 secondary school students in Barcelona from 11 randomly selected schools.

pmc-12587061.title: Stakeholders’ perspectives of dental imaging in the current diagnostic radiography curriculum
pmc-12587061.creator: Keshini Govindasami, Shenuka Singh
pmc-12587061.description: BackgroundDental imaging supports accurate diagnosis of orofacial anomalies and is included in diagnostic radiography training in South Africa (SA). Yet, there is limited published evidence on these professionals’ competencies to perform such tasks. It is unclear whether dental imaging is explicitly expressed in the undergraduate curricula for diagnostic radiography.

pmc-13247858.title: Thrombotic Risk and Hemostatic Profiles in Pediatric Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Association with Disease Activity
pmc-13247858.creator: Yasin Maruf Ergen, Edibe Gözde Başaran, Selçuk Teke, Tuğba Çaviş, Necati Balamtekin
pmc-13247858.description: Background/Aims:Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) increases thromboembolic risk, but pediatric evidence remains limited. The current study evaluated the associations between coagulation markers, systemic inflammation, and disease activity in pediatric IBD and assessed the prevalence of silent thrombosis.Materials and Methods:A total of 46 pediatric patients with IBD were enrolled in this single-center cross-sectional study.

pmc-13349723.title: Chronic eczematous eruptions of aging: a clinical practice review
pmc-13349723.creator: J. Skylar Westerdahl, Richard D. Sontheimer
pmc-13349723.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Chronic eczematous skin disorders that first appear in later life are poorly characterized, partly because existing terminology is inconsistent and often conflates morphologic descriptors with specific diagnoses. This review introduces chronic eczematous eruptions of aging (CEEsA) as an umbrella term, summarizes current knowledge on its epidemiology, etiologies, and clinical presentation, outlines best practices in management, and highlights gaps requiring further investigation.

pmc-13381309.title: A century of anti-G straining maneuvers. Are there further changes in AGSM physical training that can improve +Gz tolerance? A scoping review
pmc-13381309.creator: David G. Behm, Ethan D Lawson, Blake C. W. Martin
pmc-13381309.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). High +Gz force tolerance is vital for pilot survival and aircraft performance capabilities. Over the last century, devices such as anti-G suits, pressurized breathing, seat configurations, audio-visual displays to monitor physiological responses, and other techniques have been developed. Anti-G straining maneuvers (AGSM) were also developed to combat the cerebral blood flow reductions that could lead to vision loss, +Gz-force induced loss of consciousness (G-LOC), and pilot performance impairments.

pmc-13392756.title: Electrolyte additive engineering to construct stable interphases with high ionic conductivity for high-temperature and high-voltage lithium metal batteries
pmc-13392756.creator: Yanan Li, Wenzhe Zhang, Xiaosha Wu, Rui Yu, Kun Wang, Kai Xi, Shujiang Ding, Guoxin Gao
pmc-13392756.description: Integrating high-voltage nickel-rich cathodes with lithium metal anodes while elevating charging cut-off voltage is a practical strategy for constructing high-energy-density battery systems. Nevertheless, severe structural degradation of cathodes and aggressive electrode/electrolyte interfacial reactions hinder their application. Worse still, these issues are exacerbated under high-voltage and high-temperature operating conditions.

pmc-13480079.title: The phase I trial of preoperative short-course chemoradiotherapy with S-1/irinotecan and short-course radiation in locally advanced lower rectal cancer (SHOWTIME study)
pmc-13480079.creator: Ken Kojo, Toshimichi Tanaka, Takahiro Yamanashi, Hirohisa Miura, Keigo Yokoi, Keita Kojima, Kazuko Yokota, Shogo Kawakami, Hiromichi Ishiyama, Keishi Yamashita, Yusuke Kumamoto, Naoki Hiki, Takeo Sato, Takeshi Naitoh

pmc-13487197.title: Surface circumferential spinal cord recording in freely moving rodents
pmc-13487197.creator: Salim El Hadwe, Ruben Ruiz-Mateos Serrano, George Psaltakis, Margaux Forner, Chaeyeon Lee, Sydney Swedick, Anton Banta, Xueer Zhang, Moleca Ghannam, Tawfique Hasan, Alejandro Carnicer-Lombarte, George G. Malliaras, Damiano G. Barone
pmc-13487197.description: Spinal cord injury affects over 2.5 million people worldwide, yet current neuroprosthetic strategies remain fragmented, addressing motor, sensory, or autonomic function in isolation. Here we show that a single ultrathin circumferential electrode array, conforming to the spinal cord without penetrating neural tissue, can simultaneously decode motor intent, classify sensory inputs, and discriminate visceral sensory inputs.

pmc-13521275.title: Phase separation of DUX family proteins drives totipotent-like state via 3D genome reorganization and retrotransposon activation
pmc-13521275.creator: Leilei Gao, Qifeng Gao, Na Hai, Ziqiang Wu, Penghui Li, Han Kang, Xiaohui Song, Jinlian Hua, Shiqiang Zhang, Gang Ren, Jihong Yang, Leqian Yu, Yulei Wei, Junjun Ding, Fan Yang
pmc-13521275.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The acquisition of totipotency requires transcriptional activation of endogenous retroviruses (MERVL/HERVL) and zygotic genome activation (ZGA) related genes, yet the molecular mechanisms linking chromatin architecture to this process remain elusive. Here, we demonstrate that mouse Dux and human DUX4, double homeobox transcription factors essential for totipotency, form liquid–liquid phase-separated (LLPS) condensates through conserved arginine residues within intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) in the Homeobox domain.

pmc-13701136.title: Psychopathology from childhood to adolescence in children with and without Mild Intellectual Disability (MID): a comparison across three MID operationalizations
pmc-13701136.creator: Dogukan Koc, Maurits Masselink, Stefania Barzeva, Daan H. G. Hulsmans, Nanda N. J. Rommelse, Roy Otten, Catharina A. Hartman, Pauline W. Jansen
pmc-13701136.description: The DSM-5(-TR) expanded the definition of Mild Intellectual Disability (MID) to include adaptive functioning (AF) alongside intelligence quotient (IQ). In this population-based study, we examined behavioural and emotional problems in children with MID and matched controls from early childhood to adolescence. We evaluated how three operationalizations of MID, varying by IQ and AF, influence outcomes.
